name: How do I know if my railing needs repair or full replacement?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my railing needs repair or full replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Determining whether your railing needs repair or full replacement depends on the extent of the damage. Minor issues like a few loose pickets or a small section of rot can often be repaired. However, widespread structural damage, significant rot in support posts, or extensive material degradation typically necessitate a full replacement. Frasheski Construction provides site assessments to evaluate the railing's condition and recommend the most cost-effective and safest long-term solution based on our experience in the Berkeley and East Bay areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor damage often allows for repair, while widespread structural issues or rot usually require full replacement. We assess to recommend the best solution.
